question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：奥地利 vs 约旦（2026-06-17）90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Austria vs Jordan (2026-06-17) — result after 90 minutes?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差 150 分加上约旦近 5 场不胜丢 11 球，奥地利约 55% 占优；但 Baumgartner 伤退令优势打折，约旦爆冷窗口未关死。
one_liner_en: A 150-point Elo gap and Jordan's winless, leaky run give Austria ~55%; Baumgartner's tournament-ending injury trims that edge and keeps Jordan's upset window ajar.

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利核心中场 Baumgartner 髋部肌腱重伤，缺席整届世界杯，进攻组织受损
key_reasons.en: Austria's key midfielder Baumgartner is out of the entire World Cup with a hip tendon injury, denting their creativity

key_reasons.cn: 约旦近 5 场 0 胜并丢 11 球（0-2 哥伦比亚、1-4 瑞士），且主力前锋 Al-Naimat 因 ACL 缺席
key_reasons.en: Jordan are winless in five with 11 goals conceded (0-2 Colombia, 1-4 Switzerland) and first-choice striker Al-Naimat is out with an ACL injury

key_reasons.cn: Elo 1830 vs 1680（150 分差距），中立场 Davidson 模型给出奥地利 53.3% 的统计基线
key_reasons.en: Elo 1830 vs 1680 (a 150-point gap) yields a 53.3% statistical baseline for Austria from the neutral-venue Davidson model

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue) -> p_stat 0.533/0.242/0.225; bounded sourced adjustment (net ~2pp toward Austria, cap +/-8pp) -> p_final 0.55/0.24/0.21. No betting or prediction-market data used.
